Loading the packages

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
```

Loading the dataset

```{r}
cars2018 <- read.csv("D:/Training/Academy/R Course (C-DAC)/Datasets/cars2018.csv",
                     stringsAsFactors = T)
survey <- read.csv("D:/Training/Academy/R Course (C-DAC)/Datasets/survey.csv",
                     stringsAsFactors = T)
h <- survey |> 
        filter(Sex=="Female") |> 
        select(Exer, Pulse) |> 
        group_by(Exer) |> 
        summarise(avg_pulse=mean(Pulse, na.rm=T))
h
```

```{r}
ggplot(data = survey,
       aes(x=Height, y=Pulse,color = Exer))+
  geom_point()+
  facet_grid(Exer~.)
```
